title: Office
description: A specific elective position with a jurisdiction and a term.

jurisdiction.description: The jurisdictional level of the Office.

branch.description: Branch of government. Judicial included for coverage of elective judgeships.

state.description: USPS two-letter state code, when applicable.

term_end.description: The day the seat's term ends: noon on 3 January after the Congress it belongs to (U.S. Const. amend. XX, section 1). Filled when the register reads a roster of the next Congress; null until then. It is the seat's term, never the day a person left the seat: a person the roster no longer lists is shown by a change row.
